# Lens distortion

Barrel, pincushion or mustache distortion from the Brown–Conrady radial lens model, with a choice of what fills the edges.

<EffectDemo effect="lens-distortion" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { lensDistortion } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/lens-distortion';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(lensDistortion({ preset: 'barrel' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.k1 = 0.15`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type                           | Default   | Range     | Description                                                                                      |
| --------- | ------------------------------ | --------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `k1`      | number                         | `0.15`    | -1 – 1    | Main radial term: positive bulges the center outward (barrel), negative pinches it (pincushion). |
| `k2`      | number                         | `0`       | -1 – 1    | Second radial term; opposite signs to k1 give mustache distortion.                               |
| `scale`   | number                         | `1`       | 0.5 – 1.5 | Zoom; above 1 crops the distorted edges.                                                         |
| `edges`   | 'black' \| 'clamp' \| 'mirror' | `'black'` |           | What appears where the distortion reaches past the frame.                                        |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset       | Settings                                  |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------- |
| `barrel`     | `k1: 0.28`                                |
| `pincushion` | `k1: -0.22`                               |
| `fisheye`    | `k1: 0.65`, `k2: 0.2`, `scale: 1.12`      |
| `mustache`   | `k1: 0.25`, `k2: -0.3`, `edges: 'mirror'` |

Apply one with `lensDistortion({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Lens & camera · tracked as story X4.3 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 4.1 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/lens-distortion`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Brown, Decentering distortion of lenses, Photogrammetric Engineering, 1966 (Brown–Conrady radial model).
